name: "Aero." Geist 500
note: Today's favourite. The blue full stop is the one bright thing on a page.

name: "Aero" Geist 500, no dot
note: Plainest. Loses the one memorable detail; colour moves to the product.

name: "aero." lowercase
note: Softer and more casual; closer to a tool than a company.

name: "A." mark plus "Aero"
note: A tile you can recognise at 16px, then the plain word beside it.

name: "Aero." Instrument Sans 500
note: A little warmer, rounder joins; same dot, same rules.

name: "Aero." Schibsted Grotesk 500
note: More character in the a and the r; reads editorial, less app.

name: Dot mark plus "Aero"
note: The dot alone is the mark: it becomes the playhead, the loader and the favicon.
